name: pasteguard
description: Checks pasted Python code for hallucinated packages and risky patterns.

pasteguard.minChars.description: Ignore inserted text shorter than this many characters.

pasteguard.minLines.description: Inserts with at least this many lines count as pastes.

pasteguard.singleLineChars.description: A single-line insert at least this long also counts (e.g. a long install command).

pasteguard.maxChars.description: Skip scanning pastes larger than this many characters.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/pasteDetector.test.js out/test/installParser.test.js out/test/extractor.test.js
